findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：Cummins 依賴全球供應鏈，關稅與貿易中斷（禁運、制裁、出口管制）可能衝擊生產成本、需求與客戶／供應商關係；美中出口管制與制裁變動可能影響應收帳款回收、中國現金調回、售後與保固支援及銷售。
findings.excerpt: Embargoes, sanctions and export control laws are changing rapidly for certain geographies, including with respect to China. In particular, changing U.S. export controls and sanctions on China, as well as other restrictions affecting transactions involving China and Chinese parties, could affect our ability to collect receivables, access cash generated in China, provide aftermarket and warranty support for our products, sell products and otherwise impact our reputation and business

findings.claim: 2025 年關稅淨財務影響（扣除緩解措施）對獲利與營運現金流不重大；公司透過供應商協商、替代採購與客戶成本回收緩解。
findings.excerpt: The financial impact of tariffs, net of mitigation actions, was immaterial to our profitability and operating cash flows during 2025.

findings.claim: MD&A 展望：關稅、出口管制與地緣緊張帶來不確定性，成本與關稅上升可能衝擊獲利，貿易中斷可能造成生產中斷。
findings.excerpt: Increases in costs, tariffs, as well as other inflationary pressures, could negatively impact earnings.

findings.claim: Q3 2025 財報電話會議：關稅成本於第三季上升，接近完全回收先前公布的關稅；單季淨衝擊為數千萬美元級。
findings.source: Motley Fool Q3 2025 earnings call transcript
